description: Source code for the gl::FramebufferAttachment class and related classes/functions, implementing framebuffer attachment management in OpenGL ES context within ANGLE project.

classes.name: FramebufferAttachment
classes.description: Represents a framebuffer attachment, such as textures or renderbuffers, with methods for attachment management and querying properties.

classes.name: FramebufferAttachment::Target
classes.description: Encapsulates the binding point and image index for a framebuffer attachment.

classes.name: FramebufferAttachmentObject
classes.description: Base class for objects that can be attached to a framebuffer, providing methods for attachment and content initialization.

methods.name: attach
methods.description: Attaches a resource (texture, renderbuffer, surface) to the framebuffer attachment with specified parameters.

methods.name: detach
methods.description: Detaches the current resource from the framebuffer attachment.

methods.name: initializeContents
methods.description: Initializes the contents of the attachment resource, if supported.
